features: Combines analog video from any StarNET compatible DVR with IP video from an iNEX server
Decompression for H.265, H.264, MPEG-4 and M-JPEG
Video inputs 16 Network i5; recording and display rate 480 ips @ 2M; playback 64 ips @ 2M
Approvals: FCC, CE, UL, KCC, KC
notes: Spec sheet lists Windows 7 Pro and up to 10 TB storage (12 TB without DVD); the product page lists Windows 10 and capacities up to 21 TB.
Spec sheet gives up to 64 LAN and 20 WAN remote connections; the product page gives up to 20 simultaneous connections. Remote connection count left out.
Product page states the iNEX Standard Series 4U is discontinued and replaced by the XDi 20 Series.
